semantics.clock: All sequential logic updates at positive clk edges, as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Synchronous active-high reset takes priority and sets all digits to zero at a positive edge; no between-edge reset update.
semantics.count: Increment by one decimal count at each positive edge with reset low, wrapping 9999 to 0000.
semantics.enables: Combinational current-state carry conditions: ena[0] when ones=9, ena[1] when lower two digits=99, ena[2] when lower three digits=999. Reset does not gate these conditions.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; do not initialize RTL. Verification establishes known state with synchronous reset.

numeric.encoding: Four unsigned 4-bit BCD digits: ones q[3:0], tens q[7:4], hundreds q[11:8], thousands q[15:12]
numeric.illegal_bcd: Behavior outside legal BCD state is unspecified

verification.oracle: Independent integer modulo-10000 count converted to BCD; enables computed from integer decimal remainders
verification.sampling: Check settled outputs after positive edges, and stability at falling edges and between edges during reset assertion
verification.coverage: All 10000 states and wraparound, sustained counting, reset while counting, held reset, reset at nonzero carry condition
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, explicit PASS

specification_ambiguities.issue: Enable bit mapping and timing not explicitly enumerated
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use ena[0] for digit 1, ena[1] for digit 2, ena[2] for digit 3; current lower-digit carry conditions indicate increment on the upcoming edge.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Reset value and overflow not written numerically
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use conventional decimal counter reset to 0000 and wrap from 9999 to 0000.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Power-up and invalid BCD states unspecified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No initialization or invalid-state recovery requirement; test functional behavior after reset.
